BLOCKED: the compiler refuses a struct or list holding views of a `ref` parameter when it is returned through an `if` or `match` expression (NK2302). Nothing is committed to `develop`. Report: /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/yaml/y21-events.md.report.md

- **Pre-flight passed:** the y24, y25 and y26 probes print their wanted lines on a freshly built `target/fast/nikaia`.
- **Draft fix:** I applied the run 2 draft and it is fmt-clean. Its `Event.value` mixed owned `text()` output with views, which gave two NK1106 errors. Now `value` is always a view (`Node.raw`, or an alias's name), and a new `text: String?` holds the decoded text of a `Value::Str`. `event_line` writes `text` when it is set, else `value`.
- **The blocker:** after that fix, one NK2302 remains, on `walk`'s `return match n.value { ... }`. The smallest probe is a function `one(n: ref N) -> E` that returns `if true { E { name: n.name } } else { E { name: n.name } }`. Writing `let r = ...; return r` passes. I suspect the result-source walk in `views.nika` (near `rsrc_function`) does not follow the arms of an `if` or `match`. The full probe is under `Found:` in the report.
- **Where the work is:** the improved draft is on the local branch `wip/y21-events` at 1c1199d6. I wrote that commit without touching the shared checkout, then put my two files there back to their state at HEAD. Run 4, after a fix for the defect, applies `git diff 6269eca3 1c1199d6 -- packages/yaml/src/main.nika packages/yaml/tests/events.nika | git apply`.
- **Not run:** the package tests and the `.stdout` bless, because the package does not compile yet.
- **Disk:** `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 3.7 GB and `/` has 11 GB free. This run created no new cache entries.
